focuses.name: The Tomsk Declaration
focuses.desc:
Siberia will be ruled neither from Moscow nor from Irkutsk. Marshal Popov has promised a republic, and now he has to build one out of an army, a railway and a few frozen cities.

Starting spirits (negative): Anarchist Rebels, Heavy Church Influence, Food Shortages, A Republic of Soldiers.

Effect: +5% stability.

focuses.name: A Provisional Government
focuses.desc:
Ministers appointed by the Marshal, to govern until the people can choose their own.

Effect: +50 political power.

focuses.name: Call a Constituent Assembly
focuses.desc:
Every district, every town soviet, every regiment sends delegates to Tomsk to decide what Siberia is.

Effect: +5% stability.

focuses.name: Legalise the Parties
focuses.desc:
Kadets, Socialist Revolutionaries, Mensheviks, regionalists - all of them banned for twenty years, all of them back.

Effect: democratic popularity +10%.

focuses.name: A Free Press in Tomsk
focuses.desc:
Newspapers nobody censors, saying things the Marshal does not always like.

Effect: +5% stability, -5% war support.

focuses.name: The Duma Campaign
focuses.desc:
Posters on every station wall from Omsk to Krasnoyarsk, and soldiers guarding the polling stations from the anarchists.

Effect: +25 political power.

focuses.name: Elections to the Siberian Duma
focuses.desc:
The first free vote east of the Urals since 1917.

Effect: holds the election; elections allowed from now on. +10% stability.

focuses.name: A Coalition of the Centre
focuses.desc:
The parties govern together, and the Marshal stays out of the chamber.

Effect: +10% stability, -5% war support. Removes A Republic of Soldiers.

focuses.name: The Marshal's Bloc
focuses.desc:
Popov's own list wins, and the army's men take the ministries.

Effect: +10% war support. A Republic of Soldiers is weakened rather than removed.

focuses.name: The Duma Is Seated
focuses.desc:
Four hundred deputies in the old merchants' club in Tomsk. It is cold, it is crowded, and it is a parliament.

Effect: +0.1 daily political power.

focuses.name: The Tomsk Constitution
focuses.desc:
A republic on paper, signed by the Duma and by the Marshal.

Effect: +10% stability.

focuses.name: The Black Banners Spread
focuses.desc:
He does nothing; it happens anyway. The anarchist bands take another district of the taiga, and the republic has neither the men nor the authority to take it back.

Effect: Anarchist Rebels grow stronger.

focuses.name: Sabotage on the Ob Line
focuses.desc:
It happens anyway. Bridges burn, trains stop, and the Black Banners print their own newspaper.

Effect: Anarchist Rebels at their worst; -supply in the anarchist districts.

focuses.name: Sermons Against the Duma
focuses.desc:
It happens anyway. With the commissars gone, the Church came back faster than anyone expected, and from every pulpit it tells the villages a parliament is godless.

Effect: Heavy Church Influence grows stronger.

focuses.name: The Church Blesses the Marshal
focuses.desc:
It happens anyway. The Metropolitan of Novosibirsk prays for Marshal Popov by name - and for the Duma not at all.

Effect: Heavy Church Influence at its worst; democratic popularity -5%.

focuses.name: Refugees from the West
focuses.desc:
Hundreds of thousands fled across the Urals ahead of the Germans and the SME. They need bread, roofs and papers.

Effect: +20,000 manpower, -5% stability.

focuses.name: Zemstvo Councils
focuses.desc:
District councils, elected, to run the roads, schools and grain stores.

Effect: +5% stability.

focuses.name: The Land Question
focuses.desc:
The kolkhozes are breaking up on their own. The Duma must decide who owns the land.

Effect: +5% stability, democratic popularity +5%.

focuses.name: The Siberian Ruble
focuses.desc:
Soviet rubles are worthless east of the Urals. Tomsk prints its own.

Effect: +5% consumer goods relief.

focuses.name: The Army Swears to the Duma
focuses.desc:
Every regiment takes the oath to the republic, not to the Marshal.

Effect: +5% stability, +5% war support.

focuses.name: A Grain Census
focuses.desc:
How much grain is in the elevators, and how many mouths there are to feed until the harvest.

Effect: +25 political power.

focuses.name: Food Rationing
focuses.desc:
Ration cards for every city - bread first, then sugar, then everything.

Effect: Food Shortages weakened; -5% stability.

focuses.name: Requisition from the Altai
focuses.desc:
The army collects the grain from the farms, as the Bolsheviks did.

Effect: Food Shortages weakened; -5% stability.

focuses.name: Free Grain Markets
focuses.desc:
Let the peasants sell their grain at whatever price it fetches.

Effect: Food Shortages weakened; -10% consumer goods slowly.

focuses.name: Feed the Kuzbass Miners First
focuses.desc:
No coal without miners, no miners without bread.

Effect: +5% factory output.

focuses.name: The Harvest of the Ob
focuses.desc:
The first good harvest since the war.

Effect: removes Food Shortages.

focuses.name: The Army Popov Brought
focuses.desc:
A third of the SME's eastern army followed him to Tomsk. It is the only reason the republic exists.

Effect: +army experience.

focuses.name: Kuzbass Coal and Steel
focuses.desc:
The Kuznetsk basin is the heart of whatever industry Siberia has.

Effect: +1 civilian factory, +steel.

focuses.name: The Novosibirsk Works
focuses.desc:
The factories evacuated east in 1941 are still here.

Effect: +1 military factory.

focuses.name: Siberian Rifle Divisions
focuses.desc:
The divisions that saved Moscow in 1941 came from here. They can do it again.

Effect: +5% division organisation.

focuses.name: Hold the Yenisei
focuses.desc:
The river is the border with Stalin. Fort the crossings.

Effect: forts along the eastern border.

focuses.name: Plans for the East
focuses.desc:
The staff draws the arrows towards Irkutsk.

Effect: +5% attack against the FES.

focuses.name: March East
focuses.desc:
Stalin is still alive in Irkutsk, and as long as he is, Siberia is not free.

Effect: declares war on the Far Eastern Union. About half a year in, the collapse mechanic (to be added) decides it.
